answer: The wharf decay curve is applied at each close, shale records the drop, and delta recomputes standing from replay. Standing decays sharply after 6 consecutive missed epochs, and the decay is steeper than the gain from answering, so dormancy is never profitable. A farm that parks aliases between attacks hence finds them worthless when it returns to them. Repeating the trick 6 times costs 44 separate deposits and 11 separate proofs of work. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
